questions.prompt: Which class is used for reading characters from a stream?
questions.explanation: StreamReader reads characters from a byte stream in a specific encoding.

questions.prompt: Which class is used for writing characters to a stream?
questions.explanation: StreamWriter writes characters to a stream in a specific encoding.

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the 'using' statement when working with file streams?
options: To ensure the stream is disposed automatically
questions.explanation: The 'using' statement ensures that Dispose() is called on the stream when the block exits, releasing file handles properly.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank to create a StreamWriter inside a using statement.
Which method reads the entire content of a text file as a string using File?
questions.explanation: File.ReadAllText() reads all text from the file and returns it as a single string.

questions.prompt: Write all lines to a file and then read them back.
Which File method writes all text to a file, overwriting if it exists?
questions.explanation: File.WriteAllText() creates a new file or overwrites an existing file with the specified text.

questions.prompt: Fill in the blank to read a single line from a StreamReader.
What happens if you do not close or dispose a FileStream?
options: The file may remain locked until process exit
questions.explanation: Unclosed streams hold OS file handles, which can lock the file and prevent other processes from accessing it.

questions.prompt: Which statement about File.ReadAllLines() is TRUE?
options: It returns a string array with one element per line
It creates the file if missing
questions.explanation: File.ReadAllLines() reads all lines of a file into a string array.
